title: Reconcile Output
description: JSON produced by agent-reconcile.py after diagnosing a pycsl proof failure.

language.description: Programming language of the source file.

author.description: Agent or person that produced the recommendation.

recommendation.description: Human-readable description of the recommended fix.

target.description: Where the fix should be applied.

fault_class.description: CMMI cross-level reconciliation routing (level-definitions.md): 'sub-actor' = this unit's body/annotation detail is wrong (re-patch at L5); 'specifier' = the file's decomposition / callee-contract ordering is wrong (escalate to L4 — re-decompose); 'verifier' = the proof obligations are mis-scoped (Rocq fallback or human).
